content: next-intl recommends building alternates.languages via getPathname({locale, href}) composed with an absolute host, rather than hand-concatenating locale prefixes onto paths, since locale prefix strategy (as-needed/always/never) can vary and getPathname resolves it correctly. For CMS-driven slugs that differ per locale (not the case in this project — slug is unlocalized per D-01/D-04/D-06), next-intl says to source alternate URLs from the CMS/sitemap generator rather than static route mapping.
